# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.6 Module 3: Civilization Regencies, Heir Educations & Designated Heir Reasons (oe_reg_). Generated by gen_v96_regency_edu.py; edit the generator, not this file.

namespace = oe_reg

# 1. Byzantine Porphyrogenitus Empress Regency starts
oe_reg.1 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_byz_senate_consistorium.dds"
	title = oe_reg.1.t
	desc = oe_reg.1.d

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		has_regent = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_reg.1.a
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_reg.1.a.tt
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_reg_purple_chamber_mandate
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_reg.1.b
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_reg.1.b.tt
		add_estate_satisfaction = {
			type = estate_type:nobles_estate
			value = estate_satisfaction_weak_bonus
		}
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
	}
}

# 6. Kurultai Regency ends: acclamation of the new Khan / Emperor
oe_reg.6 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_steppe_cavalry_clash.dds"
	title = oe_reg.6.t
	desc = oe_reg.6.d

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		has_ruler = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_reg.6.a
		ai_chance = { base = 60 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_reg.6.a.tt
		if = {
			limit = { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde }
			add_horde_unity = horde_unity_mild_bonus
		}
		else = {
			add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_reg_kurultai_acclamation
			years = 5
			mode = replace
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_reg_heir_charter_cd }
				any_character = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_ruler = no
					is_heir = no
					is_eligible_heir = root
				}
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_reg.10 days = 5 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_reg.6.b
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_reg.6.b.tt
		add_estate_satisfaction = {
			type = estate_type:nobles_estate
			value = estate_satisfaction_mild_bonus
		}
		add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_reg_heir_charter_cd }
				any_character = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_ruler = no
					is_heir = no
					is_eligible_heir = root
				}
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_reg.10 days = 5 }
		}
	}
}

# 10. Imperial Heir Designation Charter: showcases all 6 civilization designated_heir_reason entries
oe_reg.10 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_byz_diplomacy.dds"
	title = oe_reg.10.title
	desc = oe_reg.10.desc

	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		has_ruler = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_reg_heir_charter_cd value = 1 years = 20 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_ruler = no
					is_heir = no
					is_eligible_heir = root
					has_dynasty = yes
					root.ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes }
					dynasty = root.ruler.dynasty
				}
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_ruler = no
					is_heir = no
					is_eligible_heir = root
					has_dynasty = yes
					root.ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes }
					dynasty = root.ruler.dynasty
				}
				order_by = total_abilities
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = oe_reg_candidate
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_ruler = no
					is_heir = no
					is_eligible_heir = root
				}
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_ruler = no
					is_heir = no
					is_eligible_heir = root
				}
				order_by = total_abilities
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = oe_reg_candidate
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_character = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_adult = yes
					is_ruler = no
					is_heir = no
					is_eligible_heir = root
				}
			}
			ordered_character = {
				limit = {
					is_alive = yes
					is_adult = yes
					is_ruler = no
					is_heir = no
					is_eligible_heir = root
				}
				order_by = total_abilities
				max = 1
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = oe_reg_caesar_candidate
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_reg.10.a
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = BYZ
				has_or_had_tag = ROM
			}
			exists = scope:oe_reg_candidate
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_reg.10.a.tt
		set_as_designated_heir_with_reason_effect = {
			target = scope:oe_reg_candidate
			reason = oe_porphyrogenitus_co_emperor
		}
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_reg.10.b
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = BYZ
				has_or_had_tag = ROM
			}
			exists = scope:oe_reg_candidate
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_reg.10.b.tt
		set_as_designated_heir_with_reason_effect = {
			target = scope:oe_reg_candidate
			reason = oe_despot_of_morea_heir
		}
		add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_reg.10.c
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = BYZ
				has_or_had_tag = ROM
			}
			exists = scope:oe_reg_caesar_candidate
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 15 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_reg.10.c.tt
		set_as_designated_heir_with_reason_effect = {
			target = scope:oe_reg_caesar_candidate
			reason = oe_adopted_caesar
		}
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_reg.10.d
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				tag = CHI
				tag = YUA
			}
			exists = scope:oe_reg_candidate
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_reg.10.d.tt
		set_as_designated_heir_with_reason_effect = {
			target = scope:oe_reg_candidate
			reason = oe_yuan_crown_prince_zhongshu
		}
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_reg.10.e
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				tag = CHI
				tag = YUA
				tag = GLH
				tag = WHO
				tag = TIM
			}
			exists = scope:oe_reg_candidate
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_reg.10.e.tt
		set_as_designated_heir_with_reason_effect = {
			target = scope:oe_reg_candidate
			reason = oe_yuan_kurultai_chosen
		}
		add_army_tradition = army_tradition_weak_bonus
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_reg.10.f
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_or_had_tag = MOS
				has_or_had_tag = RUS
				has_or_had_tag = NOV
				has_or_had_tag = TVE
				has_or_had_tag = RYA
			}
			exists = scope:oe_reg_candidate
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_reg.10.f.tt
		set_as_designated_heir_with_reason_effect = {
			target = scope:oe_reg_candidate
			reason = oe_rus_grand_prince_testament
		}
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_reg.10.g
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
		custom_tooltip = oe_reg.10.g.tt
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
	}
